message: As the preliminary matches played out, one day passed after another. The final day of the Martial Festival qualifiers had finally arrived.

name: Iori
message: 「...Well then, today marks the end of the qualifiers.」
I call out to everyone in the Takamura Class, all gathered together.

name: Iori
message: 「Let's review our current standing, everyone.」

name: Iori
message: 「First off, Momiji—you're currently undefeated and sitting at the top of the leaderboard alone. It's safe to say your spot in the main tournament is locked in.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, Victoria gave me a bit of a hard time, but the others weren't that much of a challenge, I suppose.」
Fortunately, Momiji hadn't faced any members of the Takamura Class, so she hadn't handed anyone a loss.

name: Iori
message: 「And... Setsugekka, your performance has been remarkable. You won your last match, bringing you to third place in the qualifiers. You're in top form.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes! I feel like I've finally managed to control my runaway power. At this rate, maybe becoming a Toujinegi will be a breeze, right? ...Or so I hope!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, don't let your guard down.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Of course I know that! There were so many strong people in the qualifiers, too. The main tournament is probably going to be even tougher...」
Even after defeating Asahi, Setsugekka continued to rack up victories with unstoppable momentum. She was drawing attention as the dark horse of this tournament.

name: Asahi
message: 「I may have lost to you in the qualifiers, Setsugekka, but I absolutely won't lose in the main tournament...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ooh, that’s scary. Do you still have some hidden trick up your sleeve？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehe, it’s a secret.」

name: Iori
message: 「I think it’s safe to say Setsugekka's spot in the main tournament is basically guaranteed as well.」
Setsugekka has already finished all of her preliminary matches.
It is nearly impossible for any of the remaining members to knock Setsugekka down to eighth place or lower.

name: Iori
message: 「However... Asahi and Ririmu, you two are having a tougher time.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「U-ugh, I know it’s tough, but I can still do this！ There’s no way I’m finishing here！」

name: Asahi
message: 「The third-years have studied Ririmu-san well, and they’ve been countering her illusions quite effectively.」
Asahi was right.
It seems rumors of Ririmu's illusions had spread gradually among the first-years who encountered them during midterm exams and the like, and they had devised countermeasures based on them.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, now that I’ve come this far, there’s no point in panicking. I’m going all out without holding anything back！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that’s all you can do.」

name: Iori
message: 「Especially for the third-years, this Martial Festival is their last chance. They must be putting a lot of heart into it.」

name: Iori
message: 「The top-tier participants are Momiji, Setsugekka, Victoria, and Shizuku, but it's quite a chaotic scramble for the rest of the spots.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, Ririmu, you both still have plenty of chances to advance to the main tournament. The next match will likely be the make-or-break moment」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi’s opponent is Taiga Igarashi. He’s a real powerhouse, easily in the top five among the third-years」

name: Asahi
message: 「……That sounds like it’s going to be a tough match. But, I will win.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, your opponent is… Arakawa Sonomi from the second year.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, *that* Arakawa-paisen? Seriously?！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehh, it’s Sono-chan-senpai？ Lucky, so lucky！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Not lucky at all！ Unlike you, Secchan, I just don't get along with her. It feels like she's always angry.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I wish she’d just lighten up and have some fun.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sono-chan-senpai is a cool beauty, you know. It wouldn't be cool if she were just sitting there grinning all the time!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Are you talking about yourself when you say ‘grinning all the time’？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No… wait, that makes it sound like I’m the uncool one!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You were the one who said it. You said grinning is uncool.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Geez! Anyway, Sono-chan-senpai might be hard to approach, but I'm telling you, she's not actually a bad person!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Only you would have that sense for it, Setsugekka.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I find it completely impossible to understand as well.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Same here.」
Hmm, it seems Arakawa isn't very popular in Takamura Class. I don't really dislike that wild type, though.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「……Hey, Muragaki. Isn't this match result a bit strange?」
Keisetsu, who had been silent up until then, spoke up.

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm? Is there something wrong with Arakawa's match records?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Every match she's lost was by judge's decision…」
Now that she mentions it, I notice.
I had overlooked it because the summary field for the matches only had 'Decision' written in small print.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, so that means Senpai has never lost except by decision？ That’s amazing, isn't it！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah… so that's it.」
Momiji has a slightly grim look on her face.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Momitchi, what do you mean？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Just when you think you've taken her down, she recovers right away. Even though her Barrier Jacket should've been completely depleted」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If that's the case, why did she lose by decision？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even when she was on the back foot and getting beaten to a pulp, she stayed on her feet until the end with her Barrier Jacket still intact」

name: Momiji
message: 「Throughout these qualifiers, not a single person managed to knock her out. That's why every one of those matches ended in a decision loss, right」
A chill ran through the group.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nobody could take her down... Hey, hold on a second」

name: Ririmu
message: 「A Barrier Jacket that never goes down—that basically makes her invincible！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, what on earth is...」

name: Iori
message: 「The only explanation I can think of... is her Tenju trait」

name: Iori
message: 「Judging from how her practice match with Momiji went earlier, there's no doubt the damage was getting through」

name: Iori
message: 「However, she's probably restoring her Barrier Jacket by some means. Though I don't know how」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaat, is that even allowed！？」

name: Iori
message: 「As long as it's a Tenju, it should basically stop functioning once her mental stamina and focus run out, though...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, this is... pretty reckless, isn't it. If things go wrong, Arakawa-senpai could end up permanently out of commission」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What do you mean, permanently out of commission？」

name: Iori
message: 「It's true that as long as her Barrier Jacket remains, no matter how many hits she takes, it doesn't count as a loss under match rules」

name: Iori
message: 「However, a Barrier Jacket can't nullify the impact or pain of the blows. As you all already know」

name: Iori
message: 「Arakawa-san is likely taking heavy physical damage, and pushing through it on sheer willpower alone」

name: Iori
message: 「If she's not careful, it wouldn't be surprising if she's left with lasting aftereffects. That's what Momiji meant」

name: Asahi
message: 「...A swordswoman who fights with total disregard for her own body, then. That is terrifying」
Asahi already seemed to have grasped her true nature.

name: Iori
message: 「Fortunately, there is a way to deal with her. Arakawa-san didn't win every match in the qualifiers」

name: Iori
message: 「Decision losses—in other words, she lost on technical points and clean hits. It might rub you the wrong way, Ririmu, but you should aim for that」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaat, aim for a decision win right from the start？ That totally doesn't fit my aesthetic, you know」
As I expected, Ririmu shows hesitation.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, this is an important bout. Think it through carefully.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Mmm... well, yeah, showing everyone my worldview in the main event is more important, but still...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Arakawa-senpai has outstanding strength and stamina. She is likely even better than I am.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh, if she’s even better than you, Asahi, she’s basically a gorilla.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Leaving that assessment aside, Ririmu-san, the match against Arakawa-san will be a battle of attrition.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Please try to land effective hits while conserving your stamina as much as possible, and hold out until the 20-minute time limit of the preliminary match.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Never take the bait if she tries to provoke you. Is that clear？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh... this is gonna be such a drag of a match.」
Ririmu’s enthusiasm is clearly fading. Hmm, that in itself is dangerous...

name: Iori
message: 「...Ririmu, a word of advice.」

name: Iori
message: 「Listen, your match is yours alone. Ultimately, I think you should do as you wish.」

name: Iori
message: 「How you fight is a reflection of how you show your own path. Sometimes there are things more important than just winning.」

name: Iori
message: 「You should make the final decision yourself. Because in the end, it’s you who has to bear the result.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hehe... Sensei, you really do get me, don’t ya~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That’s right, I’ll decide everything about myself. I won’t let anyone else have their way with me.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Because that is my worldview！！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ririmu-san...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi, thanks for all the advice. It was helpful. But I’ll be the one to decide in the end.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「The point is, I just need to knock her out without all this fuss.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I’m going to be the one to hand Arakawa-paisan her first non-decision loss in these preliminaries！」
Ririmu is suddenly brimming with motivation. That’s right, you mustn't be overwhelmed before the fight even begins.

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that’s the spirit. I know you can do it, Ririmu.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Good luck, Ririmu-san.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi, you worry about yourself and go win your own match too！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, of course.」
A loud cheer went up from the venue. It seems the previous match has concluded.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It looks like it's about time.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah！ I don't have any more matches, but you guys go give it your all！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Right, let's keep a level head.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, let's all do our best.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Alright, let's win this！」

name: Iori
message: 「Everyone, you've all worked really hard to get here. Let's make it through this final day of the qualifiers safely！！」
The competitors left the waiting area. Their faces were already those of people ready to fight.
